capabilities: Pace notes, PDFs and EPUBs with a moving highlighter
Set reading speed in words per minute with frequency-based smart pacing
Play, pause, and step back or forward by word or sentence with keyboard keys
Jump to any word by clicking it
Switch between Flow and Focus views and resume each file at your saved place
extras: Also ships as a Chrome extension and a web app at pacer.hla.dev; the Obsidian plugin is desktop only and the README states it makes no network requests and stores settings locally.
motivation: The author rejects one-word-at-a-time flash readers because a missed word takes the sentence with it and there is no paragraph to glance back at.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to read long notes or documents at a controlled pace, and typical speed-reading apps flash single words so a missed word loses its context.
summary: Speed-reading tool that moves a highlighter through notes, PDFs and EPUBs at a words-per-minute pace you set.
